question: Identify male patients who have had at least two laboratory tests showing elevated hematocrit (HCT ≥ 52), and whose IgG levels were above normal (IGG ≥ 2000) in any of their lab records. For these patients, return their ID, current age, and the highest hemoglobin (HGB) value observed across all their lab tests.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    p.XCL_058,
    STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_060) AS current_age,
    MAX(l.XCL_032) AS highest_hemoglobin
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE p.XCL_059 = 'M'
  AND p.XCL_058 IN (
    SELECT l2.XCL_014
    FROM Laboratory AS l2
    WHERE l2.XCL_033 >= 52
    GROUP BY l2.XCL_014
    HAVING COUNT(l2.XCL_014) >= 2
  )
  AND p.XCL_058 IN (
    SELECT l3.XCL_014
    FROM Laboratory AS l3
    WHERE l3.XCL_042 >= 2000
  )
GROUP BY p.XCL_058, p.XCL_060

SELECT
    p.XCL_058,
    STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_060) AS current_age,
    MAX(l.XCL_032) AS highest_hemoglobin
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE p.XCL_059 = 'M'
  AND p.XCL_058 IN (
    SELECT l2.XCL_014
    FROM Laboratory AS l2
    WHERE l2.XCL_033 >= 52
    GROUP BY l2.XCL_014
    HAVING COUNT(l2.XCL_014) >= 2
  )
  AND p.XCL_058 IN (
    SELECT l3.XCL_014
    FROM Laboratory AS l3
    WHERE l3.XCL_042 >= 2000
  )
GROUP BY p.XCL_058, p.XCL_060

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT p.XCL_058, p.XCL_060, MAX(l.XCL_017) AS max_hgb
FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE p.XCL_059 = 'M'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l2
    WHERE l2.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058 AND l2.XCL_042 >= 2000
  )
GROUP BY p.XCL_058, p.XCL_060
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN l.XCL_016 >= 52 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY max_hgb DESC
LIMIT 1
